manifest:
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: moimroom-db-eks
  namespace: moimroom
spec:
  instances: 2
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:17.11
  smartShutdownTimeout: 5
  storage:
    size: 5Gi
    storageClass: gp3
  resources:
    requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 256Mi}
    limits: {memory: 512Mi}
  bootstrap:
    pg_basebackup: {source: moimroom-db-gke, database: app, owner: app, secret: {name: moimroom-db-gke-app}}
  replica: {self: moimroom-db-eks, primary: moimroom-db-gke, source: moimroom-db-gke}
  externalClusters:
    - name: moimroom-db-gke
      connectionParameters: {host: moimroom-db-gke-rw.moimroom.gke.ts.net, user: streaming_replica, dbname: postgres, sslmode: verify-full}
notes: 원본 DB 2.1 GiB, 쓰기 초당 약 20건이라 maxLagBytes 1 MiB로 둠
대상 EKS의 기본 StorageClass gp3를 씀
